summary: GrafTech entered into an equity distribution agreement (May 29, 2026) to sell up to $50M of common stock via an at-the-market (ATM) offering through Evercore as agent. Stock price was $10.00/share on May 28. The company pays a 3.0% commission; settlement next trading day via DTC. This is a shelf takedown under Rule 415 — proceeds typically used for general corporate purposes or capital returns. No board recommendation or advisor mentioned. The ATM structure allows gradual issuance, reducing market overhang. Watch dilution pace and use of proceeds for buybacks or debt reduction.
